```sql
WITH r0 AS (SELECT `books_receivable_items`.* FROM `books_receivable_items` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
r1 AS (SELECT `books_customers`.* FROM `books_customers` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
w AS (SELECT [[t1.id]] AS __id, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS c0, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS c9, [[t1.item]] AS c10, [[t1.currency]] AS ck0, COALESCE(NULLIF([[t3.id]], ''), NULLIF([[t2.id]], '')) AS k0, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS k1, [[t1.item]] AS k2, [[t1.debit]] AS h8, [[t1.credit]] AS h9, NULLIF(substr([[t1.due_date]], 1, 10), '') AS h10, [[t1.item_seq]] AS h11, NULLIF([[t1.item_kind]], '') AS h12, [[t1.item_number]] AS h13
```
```sql
FROM r0 t1
LEFT JOIN r1 t2 ON [[t2.id]] = [[t1.customer]]
```

## Run 5 customer opened, statement 6

```sql
WITH r0 AS (SELECT `books_receivable_items`.* FROM `books_receivable_items` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
r1 AS (SELECT `books_customers`.* FROM `books_customers` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
w AS (SELECT [[t1.id]] AS __id, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS c0, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS c9, [[t1.item]] AS c10, [[t1.currency]] AS ck0, COALESCE(NULLIF([[t3.id]], ''), NULLIF([[t2.id]], '')) AS k0, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS k1, [[t1.item]] AS k2, [[t1.debit]] AS h8, [[t1.credit]] AS h9, NULLIF(substr([[t1.due_date]], 1, 10), '') AS h10, [[t1.item_seq]] AS h11, NULLIF([[t1.item_kind]], '') AS h12, [[t1.item_number]] AS h13
FROM r0 t1
LEFT JOIN r1 t2 ON [[t2.id]] = [[t1.customer]]
LEFT JOIN r1 t3 ON [[t3.id]] = [[t2.parent]]
WHERE (([[t1.settled]] > '2026-11-18') AND (NULLIF(substr([[t1.date]], 1, 10), '') <= '2026-11-18'))),
```

```sql
WITH r0 AS (SELECT `books_receivable_items`.* FROM `books_receivable_items` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
r1 AS (SELECT `books_customers`.* FROM `books_customers` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
```
```sql
r2 AS (SELECT `books_journal_entries`.* FROM `books_journal_entries` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
w AS (SELECT [[t1.id]] AS __id, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS c0, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS c9, [[t1.item]] AS c10, [[t1.currency]] AS ck0, COALESCE(NULLIF([[t3.id]], ''), NULLIF([[t2.id]], '')) AS k0, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS k1, [[t1.item]] AS k2, [[t1.debit]] AS h8, [[t1.credit]] AS h9, NULLIF([[t1.item_kind]], '') AS h10, [[t1.item_number]] AS h11, NULLIF(substr([[t1.due_date]], 1, 10), '') AS h12, [[t1.item_seq]] AS h13, NULLIF(substr([[t1.date]], 1, 10), '') AS h14, NULLIF([[t11.posted_at]], '') AS h15, NULLIF([[t3.id]], '') AS h16, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS h17, NULLIF([[t11.doc_type]], '') AS h18, NULLIF([[t11.origin]], '') AS h19, [[t15.number]] AS h20, [[t11.number]] AS h21, [[t11.document]] AS h22, NULLIF([[t11.id]], '') AS h23
FROM r0 t1
LEFT JOIN r1 t2 ON [[t2.id]] = [[t1.customer]]
LEFT JOIN r1 t3 ON [[t3.id]] = [[t2.parent]]
LEFT JOIN r2 t11 ON [[t11.id]] = [[t1.entry]]
LEFT JOIN r2 t15 ON [[t15.id]] = [[t11.reverses]]
WHERE (([[t1.settled]] > '2026-11-18') AND (NULLIF(substr([[t1.date]], 1, 10), '') <= '2026-11-18'))),
a1 AS (SELECT k0, ck0, COALESCE(sum((COALESCE(w.h8, 0) - COALESCE(w.h9, 0))), 0) AS y0, count(*) AS __n FROM w GROUP BY k0, ck0),
gr1 AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, [[t4.display_name]] AS rc0, NULLIF([[t4.id]], '') AS rc1 FROM a1 a LEFT JOIN r1 t4 ON [[t4.id]] IS a.k0) a),
a2 AS (SELECT k0, k1, ck0, COALESCE(sum((COALESCE(w.h8, 0) - COALESCE(w.h9, 0))), 0) AS y0, count(*) AS __n FROM w GROUP BY k0, k1, ck0),
gr2 AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, [[t5.display_name]] AS rc0, [[t5.inactive]] AS rc1, NULLIF([[t5.id]], '') AS rc2, NULLIF([[t6.id]], '') AS rc3, [[t6.display_name]] AS rc4 FROM a2 a LEFT JOIN r1 t5 ON [[t5.id]] IS a.k1
LEFT JOIN r1 t6 ON [[t6.id]] IS a.k0) a),
a3 AS (SELECT k0, k1, k2, ck0, min(w.h10) AS y0, min(w.h11) AS y1, min(w.h12) AS y2, min(w.h13) AS y3, COALESCE(sum((COALESCE(w.h8, 0) - COALESCE(w.h9, 0))), 0) AS y4, count(*) AS __n FROM w GROUP BY k0, k1, k2, ck0),
gr3 AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, NULLIF([[t7.id]], '') AS rc0, NULLIF([[t8.id]], '') AS rc1, [[t8.display_name]] AS rc2, [[t7.display_name]] AS rc3 FROM a3 a LEFT JOIN r1 t7 ON [[t7.id]] IS a.k1
LEFT JOIN r1 t8 ON [[t8.id]] IS a.k0) a),
s3 AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT a.* FROM gr3 a WHERE COALESCE((a.y4 IS NOT 0), 0)),
```

## Run 7 CSV export, statement 42

```sql
WITH r0 AS (SELECT `books_receivable_items`.* FROM `books_receivable_items` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
r1 AS (SELECT `books_customers`.* FROM `books_customers` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
r2 AS (SELECT `books_journal_entries`.* FROM `books_journal_entries` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
w AS (SELECT [[t1.id]] AS __id, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS c0, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS c9, [[t1.item]] AS c10, [[t1.currency]] AS ck0, COALESCE(NULLIF([[t3.id]], ''), NULLIF([[t2.id]], '')) AS k0, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS k1, [[t1.item]] AS k2, [[t1.debit]] AS h8, [[t1.credit]] AS h9, NULLIF([[t1.item_kind]], '') AS h10, [[t1.item_number]] AS h11, NULLIF(substr([[t1.due_date]], 1, 10), '') AS h12, [[t1.item_seq]] AS h13, NULLIF(substr([[t1.date]], 1, 10), '') AS h14, NULLIF([[t11.posted_at]], '') AS h15, NULLIF([[t3.id]], '') AS h16, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS h17, NULLIF([[t11.doc_type]], '') AS h18, NULLIF([[t11.origin]], '') AS h19, [[t15.number]] AS h20, [[t11.number]] AS h21, [[t11.document]] AS h22, NULLIF([[t11.id]], '') AS h23
FROM r0 t1
LEFT JOIN r1 t2 ON [[t2.id]] = [[t1.customer]]
LEFT JOIN r1 t3 ON [[t3.id]] = [[t2.parent]]
LEFT JOIN r2 t11 ON [[t11.id]] = [[t1.entry]]
LEFT JOIN r2 t15 ON [[t15.id]] = [[t11.reverses]]
```

```sql
WITH r0 AS (SELECT `books_receivable_items`.* FROM `books_receivable_items` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
r1 AS (SELECT `books_customers`.* FROM `books_customers` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
```
```sql
r2 AS (SELECT `books_journal_entries`.* FROM `books_journal_entries` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
w AS (SELECT [[t1.id]] AS __id, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS c0, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS c9, [[t1.item]] AS c10, [[t1.currency]] AS ck0, COALESCE(NULLIF([[t3.id]], ''), NULLIF([[t2.id]], '')) AS k0, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS k1, [[t1.item]] AS k2, [[t1.debit]] AS h8, [[t1.credit]] AS h9, NULLIF([[t1.item_kind]], '') AS h10, [[t1.item_number]] AS h11, NULLIF(substr([[t1.due_date]], 1, 10), '') AS h12, [[t1.item_seq]] AS h13, NULLIF(substr([[t1.date]], 1, 10), '') AS h14, NULLIF([[t11.posted_at]], '') AS h15, NULLIF([[t3.id]], '') AS h16, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS h17, NULLIF([[t11.doc_type]], '') AS h18, NULLIF([[t11.origin]], '') AS h19, [[t15.number]] AS h20, [[t11.number]] AS h21, [[t11.document]] AS h22, NULLIF([[t11.id]], '') AS h23
FROM r0 t1
LEFT JOIN r1 t2 ON [[t2.id]] = [[t1.customer]]
LEFT JOIN r1 t3 ON [[t3.id]] = [[t2.parent]]
LEFT JOIN r2 t11 ON [[t11.id]] = [[t1.entry]]
LEFT JOIN r2 t15 ON [[t15.id]] = [[t11.reverses]]
WHERE (([[t1.settled]] > '2026-11-18') AND (NULLIF(substr([[t1.date]], 1, 10), '') <= '2026-11-18'))),
a1 AS (SELECT k0, ck0, COALESCE(sum((COALESCE(w.h8, 0) - COALESCE(w.h9, 0))), 0) AS y0, count(*) AS __n FROM w GROUP BY k0, ck0),
gr1 AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, [[t4.display_name]] AS rc0, NULLIF([[t4.id]], '') AS rc1 FROM a1 a LEFT JOIN r1 t4 ON [[t4.id]] IS a.k0) a),
a2 AS (SELECT k0, k1, ck0, COALESCE(sum((COALESCE(w.h8, 0) - COALESCE(w.h9, 0))), 0) AS y0, count(*) AS __n FROM w GROUP BY k0, k1, ck0),
gr2 AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, [[t5.display_name]] AS rc0, [[t5.inactive]] AS rc1, NULLIF([[t5.id]], '') AS rc2, NULLIF([[t6.id]], '') AS rc3, [[t6.display_name]] AS rc4 FROM a2 a LEFT JOIN r1 t5 ON [[t5.id]] IS a.k1
LEFT JOIN r1 t6 ON [[t6.id]] IS a.k0) a),
a3 AS (SELECT k0, k1, k2, ck0, min(w.h10) AS y0, min(w.h11) AS y1, min(w.h12) AS y2, min(w.h13) AS y3, COALESCE(sum((COALESCE(w.h8, 0) - COALESCE(w.h9, 0))), 0) AS y4, count(*) AS __n FROM w GROUP BY k0, k1, k2, ck0),
gr3 AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, NULLIF([[t7.id]], '') AS rc0, NULLIF([[t8.id]], '') AS rc1, [[t8.display_name]] AS rc2, [[t7.display_name]] AS rc3 FROM a3 a LEFT JOIN r1 t7 ON [[t7.id]] IS a.k1
LEFT JOIN r1 t8 ON [[t8.id]] IS a.k0) a),
s3 AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT a.* FROM gr3 a WHERE COALESCE((a.y4 IS NOT 0), 0)),
```

```sql
WITH r0 AS (SELECT `books_receivable_items`.* FROM `books_receivable_items` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
r1 AS (SELECT `books_customers`.* FROM `books_customers` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
```
```sql
r2 AS (SELECT `books_journal_entries`.* FROM `books_journal_entries` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
w AS (SELECT [[t1.id]] AS __id, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS c0, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS c9, [[t1.item]] AS c10, [[t1.currency]] AS ck0, COALESCE(NULLIF([[t3.id]], ''), NULLIF([[t2.id]], '')) AS k0, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS k1, [[t1.item]] AS k2, [[t1.debit]] AS h8, [[t1.credit]] AS h9, NULLIF([[t1.item_kind]], '') AS h10, [[t1.item_number]] AS h11, NULLIF(substr([[t1.due_date]], 1, 10), '') AS h12, [[t1.item_seq]] AS h13, NULLIF(substr([[t1.date]], 1, 10), '') AS h14, NULLIF([[t11.posted_at]], '') AS h15, NULLIF([[t3.id]], '') AS h16, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS h17, NULLIF([[t11.doc_type]], '') AS h18, NULLIF([[t11.origin]], '') AS h19, [[t15.number]] AS h20, [[t11.number]] AS h21, [[t11.document]] AS h22, NULLIF([[t11.id]], '') AS h23
FROM r0 t1
LEFT JOIN r1 t2 ON [[t2.id]] = [[t1.customer]]
LEFT JOIN r1 t3 ON [[t3.id]] = [[t2.parent]]
LEFT JOIN r2 t11 ON [[t11.id]] = [[t1.entry]]
LEFT JOIN r2 t15 ON [[t15.id]] = [[t11.reverses]]
WHERE (([[t1.settled]] > '2026-11-18') AND (NULLIF(substr([[t1.date]], 1, 10), '') <= '2026-11-18'))),
a1 AS (SELECT k0, ck0, COALESCE(sum((COALESCE(w.h8, 0) - COALESCE(w.h9, 0))), 0) AS y0, count(*) AS __n FROM w GROUP BY k0, ck0),
gr1 AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, [[t4.display_name]] AS rc0, NULLIF([[t4.id]], '') AS rc1 FROM a1 a LEFT JOIN r1 t4 ON [[t4.id]] IS a.k0) a),
a2 AS (SELECT k0, k1, ck0, COALESCE(sum((COALESCE(w.h8, 0) - COALESCE(w.h9, 0))), 0) AS y0, count(*) AS __n FROM w GROUP BY k0, k1, ck0),
gr2 AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, [[t5.display_name]] AS rc0, [[t5.inactive]] AS rc1, NULLIF([[t5.id]], '') AS rc2, NULLIF([[t6.id]], '') AS rc3, [[t6.display_name]] AS rc4 FROM a2 a LEFT JOIN r1 t5 ON [[t5.id]] IS a.k1
LEFT JOIN r1 t6 ON [[t6.id]] IS a.k0) a),
a3 AS (SELECT k0, k1, k2, ck0, min(w.h10) AS y0, min(w.h11) AS y1, min(w.h12) AS y2, min(w.h13) AS y3, COALESCE(sum((COALESCE(w.h8, 0) - COALESCE(w.h9, 0))), 0) AS y4, count(*) AS __n FROM w GROUP BY k0, k1, k2, ck0),
gr3 AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, NULLIF([[t7.id]], '') AS rc0, NULLIF([[t8.id]], '') AS rc1, [[t8.display_name]] AS rc2, [[t7.display_name]] AS rc3 FROM a3 a LEFT JOIN r1 t7 ON [[t7.id]] IS a.k1
LEFT JOIN r1 t8 ON [[t8.id]] IS a.k0) a),
s3 AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT a.* FROM gr3 a WHERE COALESCE((a.y4 IS NOT 0), 0)),
```

## Run 7 CSV export, statement 52

```sql
WITH r0 AS (SELECT `books_receivable_items`.* FROM `books_receivable_items` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
r1 AS (SELECT `books_customers`.* FROM `books_customers` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
r2 AS (SELECT `books_journal_entries`.* FROM `books_journal_entries` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
w AS (SELECT [[t1.id]] AS __id, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS c0, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS c9, [[t1.item]] AS c10, [[t1.currency]] AS ck0, COALESCE(NULLIF([[t3.id]], ''), NULLIF([[t2.id]], '')) AS k0, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS k1, [[t1.item]] AS k2, [[t1.debit]] AS h8, [[t1.credit]] AS h9, NULLIF([[t1.item_kind]], '') AS h10, [[t1.item_number]] AS h11, NULLIF(substr([[t1.due_date]], 1, 10), '') AS h12, [[t1.item_seq]] AS h13, NULLIF(substr([[t1.date]], 1, 10), '') AS h14, NULLIF([[t11.posted_at]], '') AS h15, NULLIF([[t3.id]], '') AS h16, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS h17, NULLIF([[t11.doc_type]], '') AS h18, NULLIF([[t11.origin]], '') AS h19, [[t15.number]] AS h20, [[t11.number]] AS h21, [[t11.document]] AS h22, NULLIF([[t11.id]], '') AS h23
FROM r0 t1
LEFT JOIN r1 t2 ON [[t2.id]] = [[t1.customer]]
LEFT JOIN r1 t3 ON [[t3.id]] = [[t2.parent]]
LEFT JOIN r2 t11 ON [[t11.id]] = [[t1.entry]]
LEFT JOIN r2 t15 ON [[t15.id]] = [[t11.reverses]]
WHERE (([[t1.settled]] > '2026-11-18') AND (NULLIF(substr([[t1.date]], 1, 10), '') <= '2026-11-18'))),
a1 AS (SELECT k0, ck0, COALESCE(sum((COALESCE(w.h8, 0) - COALESCE(w.h9, 0))), 0) AS y0, count(*) AS __n FROM w GROUP BY k0, ck0),
gr1 AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, [[t4.display_name]] AS rc0, NULLIF([[t4.id]], '') AS rc1 FROM a1 a LEFT JOIN r1 t4 ON [[t4.id]] IS a.k0) a),
a2 AS (SELECT k0, k1, ck0, COALESCE(sum((COALESCE(w.h8, 0) - COALESCE(w.h9, 0))), 0) AS y0, count(*) AS __n FROM w GROUP BY k0, k1, ck0),
gr2 AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, [[t5.display_name]] AS rc0, [[t5.inactive]] AS rc1, NULLIF([[t5.id]], '') AS rc2, NULLIF([[t6.id]], '') AS rc3, [[t6.display_name]] AS rc4 FROM a2 a LEFT JOIN r1 t5 ON [[t5.id]] IS a.k1
LEFT JOIN r1 t6 ON [[t6.id]] IS a.k0) a),
a3 AS (SELECT k0, k1, k2, ck0, min(w.h10) AS y0, min(w.h11) AS y1, min(w.h12) AS y2, min(w.h13) AS y3, COALESCE(sum((COALESCE(w.h8, 0) - COALESCE(w.h9, 0))), 0) AS y4, count(*) AS __n FROM w GROUP BY k0, k1, k2, ck0),
gr3 AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, NULLIF([[t7.id]], '') AS rc0, NULLIF([[t8.id]], '') AS rc1, [[t8.display_name]] AS rc2, [[t7.display_name]] AS rc3 FROM a3 a LEFT JOIN r1 t7 ON [[t7.id]] IS a.k1
LEFT JOIN r1 t8 ON [[t8.id]] IS a.k0) a),
s3 AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT a.* FROM gr3 a WHERE COALESCE((a.y4 IS NOT 0), 0)),
```

## Run 7 CSV export, statement 62

```sql
WITH r0 AS (SELECT `books_receivable_items`.* FROM `books_receivable_items` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
r1 AS (SELECT `books_customers`.* FROM `books_customers` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
r2 AS (SELECT `books_journal_entries`.* FROM `books_journal_entries` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
w AS (SELECT [[t1.id]] AS __id, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS c0, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS c9, [[t1.item]] AS c10, [[t1.currency]] AS ck0, COALESCE(NULLIF([[t3.id]], ''), NULLIF([[t2.id]], '')) AS k0, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS k1, [[t1.item]] AS k2, [[t1.debit]] AS h8, [[t1.credit]] AS h9, NULLIF([[t1.item_kind]], '') AS h10, [[t1.item_number]] AS h11, NULLIF(substr([[t1.due_date]], 1, 10), '') AS h12, [[t1.item_seq]] AS h13, NULLIF(substr([[t1.date]], 1, 10), '') AS h14, NULLIF([[t11.posted_at]], '') AS h15, NULLIF([[t3.id]], '') AS h16, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS h17, NULLIF([[t11.doc_type]], '') AS h18, NULLIF([[t11.origin]], '') AS h19, [[t15.number]] AS h20, [[t11.number]] AS h21, [[t11.document]] AS h22, NULLIF([[t11.id]], '') AS h23
FROM r0 t1
LEFT JOIN r1 t2 ON [[t2.id]] = [[t1.customer]]
LEFT JOIN r1 t3 ON [[t3.id]] = [[t2.parent]]
LEFT JOIN r2 t11 ON [[t11.id]] = [[t1.entry]]
LEFT JOIN r2 t15 ON [[t15.id]] = [[t11.reverses]]
WHERE (([[t1.settled]] > '2026-11-18') AND (NULLIF(substr([[t1.date]], 1, 10), '') <= '2026-11-18'))),
a1 AS (SELECT k0, ck0, COALESCE(sum((COALESCE(w.h8, 0) - COALESCE(w.h9, 0))), 0) AS y0, count(*) AS __n FROM w GROUP BY k0, ck0),
gr1 AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, [[t4.display_name]] AS rc0, NULLIF([[t4.id]], '') AS rc1 FROM a1 a LEFT JOIN r1 t4 ON [[t4.id]] IS a.k0) a),
a2 AS (SELECT k0, k1, ck0, COALESCE(sum((COALESCE(w.h8, 0) - COALESCE(w.h9, 0))), 0) AS y0, count(*) AS __n FROM w GROUP BY k0, k1, ck0),
```

```sql
WITH r0 AS (SELECT `books_receivable_items`.* FROM `books_receivable_items` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
r1 AS (SELECT `books_customers`.* FROM `books_customers` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
```
```sql
r2 AS (SELECT `books_journal_entries`.* FROM `books_journal_entries` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
w AS (SELECT [[t1.id]] AS __id, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS c0, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS c9, [[t1.item]] AS c10, [[t1.currency]] AS ck0, COALESCE(NULLIF([[t3.id]], ''), NULLIF([[t2.id]], '')) AS k0, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS k1, [[t1.item]] AS k2, [[t1.debit]] AS h8, [[t1.credit]] AS h9, NULLIF([[t1.item_kind]], '') AS h10, [[t1.item_number]] AS h11, NULLIF(substr([[t1.due_date]], 1, 10), '') AS h12, [[t1.item_seq]] AS h13, NULLIF(substr([[t1.date]], 1, 10), '') AS h14, NULLIF([[t11.posted_at]], '') AS h15, NULLIF([[t3.id]], '') AS h16, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS h17, NULLIF([[t11.doc_type]], '') AS h18, NULLIF([[t11.origin]], '') AS h19, [[t15.number]] AS h20, [[t11.number]] AS h21, [[t11.document]] AS h22, NULLIF([[t11.id]], '') AS h23
FROM r0 t1
LEFT JOIN r1 t2 ON [[t2.id]] = [[t1.customer]]
LEFT JOIN r1 t3 ON [[t3.id]] = [[t2.parent]]
LEFT JOIN r2 t11 ON [[t11.id]] = [[t1.entry]]
LEFT JOIN r2 t15 ON [[t15.id]] = [[t11.reverses]]
WHERE (([[t1.settled]] > '2026-11-18') AND (NULLIF(substr([[t1.date]], 1, 10), '') <= '2026-11-18'))),
a1 AS (SELECT k0, ck0, COALESCE(sum((COALESCE(w.h8, 0) - COALESCE(w.h9, 0))), 0) AS y0, count(*) AS __n FROM w GROUP BY k0, ck0),
gr1 AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, [[t4.display_name]] AS rc0, NULLIF([[t4.id]], '') AS rc1 FROM a1 a LEFT JOIN r1 t4 ON [[t4.id]] IS a.k0) a),
a2 AS (SELECT k0, k1, ck0, COALESCE(sum((COALESCE(w.h8, 0) - COALESCE(w.h9, 0))), 0) AS y0, count(*) AS __n FROM w GROUP BY k0, k1, ck0),
gr2 AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, [[t5.display_name]] AS rc0, [[t5.inactive]] AS rc1, NULLIF([[t5.id]], '') AS rc2, NULLIF([[t6.id]], '') AS rc3, [[t6.display_name]] AS rc4 FROM a2 a LEFT JOIN r1 t5 ON [[t5.id]] IS a.k1
LEFT JOIN r1 t6 ON [[t6.id]] IS a.k0) a),
a3 AS (SELECT k0, k1, k2, ck0, min(w.h10) AS y0, min(w.h11) AS y1, min(w.h12) AS y2, min(w.h13) AS y3, COALESCE(sum((COALESCE(w.h8, 0) - COALESCE(w.h9, 0))), 0) AS y4, count(*) AS __n FROM w GROUP BY k0, k1, k2, ck0),
gr3 AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, NULLIF([[t7.id]], '') AS rc0, NULLIF([[t8.id]], '') AS rc1, [[t8.display_name]] AS rc2, [[t7.display_name]] AS rc3 FROM a3 a LEFT JOIN r1 t7 ON [[t7.id]] IS a.k1
LEFT JOIN r1 t8 ON [[t8.id]] IS a.k0) a),
s3 AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT a.* FROM gr3 a WHERE COALESCE((a.y4 IS NOT 0), 0)),
```

## Run 7 CSV export, statement 70

```sql
WITH r0 AS (SELECT `books_receivable_items`.* FROM `books_receivable_items` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
r1 AS (SELECT `books_customers`.* FROM `books_customers` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
r2 AS (SELECT `books_journal_entries`.* FROM `books_journal_entries` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='duzstsox7s7r2pr' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('duzstsox7s7r2pr' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'duzstsox7s7r2pr' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
w AS (SELECT [[t1.id]] AS __id, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS c0, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS c9, [[t1.item]] AS c10, [[t1.currency]] AS ck0, COALESCE(NULLIF([[t3.id]], ''), NULLIF([[t2.id]], '')) AS k0, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS k1, [[t1.item]] AS k2, [[t1.debit]] AS h8, [[t1.credit]] AS h9, NULLIF([[t1.item_kind]], '') AS h10, [[t1.item_number]] AS h11, NULLIF(substr([[t1.due_date]], 1, 10), '') AS h12, [[t1.item_seq]] AS h13, NULLIF(substr([[t1.date]], 1, 10), '') AS h14, NULLIF([[t11.posted_at]], '') AS h15, NULLIF([[t3.id]], '') AS h16, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS h17, NULLIF([[t11.doc_type]], '') AS h18, NULLIF([[t11.origin]], '') AS h19, [[t15.number]] AS h20, [[t11.number]] AS h21, [[t11.document]] AS h22, NULLIF([[t11.id]], '') AS h23
FROM r0 t1
LEFT JOIN r1 t2 ON [[t2.id]] = [[t1.customer]]
LEFT JOIN r1 t3 ON [[t3.id]] = [[t2.parent]]
```
